name: Melek
title: Descendant of Saul through Jonathan
summary: Melek (also known as Mikja) was a descendant of King Saul through the line of Jonathan. He is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles as the son of Mica (grandson of Mephibosheth/Meribbaal). His significance lies primarily in maintaining Saul's lineage after the fall of the royal house.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Saul's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Melek is listed as the son of Mica in the genealogy of Saul's descendants in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the genealogy
keyEvents.description: Melek's lineage is repeated in a parallel genealogy in 1 Chronicles chapter 9, confirming his place among Saul's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Continuation of Saul's dynasty
keyEvents.description: Through Melek and his descendants, Saul's lineage was preserved even after the kingdom passed to David's house.

keyEvents.title: Melek's sons
keyEvents.description: Melek had sons who continued Saul's lineage, including Pithon, Melek, Tarea, and Ahas according to the chronicler's account.
